differences: Research valid_bars requires finite positive amount for every day; production formula Evaluator only requires amount when a condition references amount.
Research also requires finite change on the oldest included bar; Evaluator checks change only on internal newer-to-older links and requested change fields.
Production numeric comparisons apply math.isclose tolerance 1e-12; vectorized research compares raw floating values.
Production screen runs _daily_context date/readiness validation; this verification explicitly runs the same check for each case.
Both use raw unadjusted daily prices and validate all internal reference links within needed windows at 0.15 percentage point tolerance.
Extra CROSS history may be unavailable without invalidating shorter base rules; production Evaluator derives a valid suffix and evaluates each rule window separately.
